Assert via formatStatusText / collectProjectStatus and source-level absence of the old filter and of any grace-cursor import.

evaluateArchiveGate: no-open-epoch remains listLooseEvents.length === 0 (predicate unchanged). When permitting and orphans exist, requirement message is **not** the string "run/ empty"; it states no foldable loose events and names orphan(s) (name and/or class) via listRunOrphans from the shared module. When run/ is truly empty, a truthful empty phrasing is allowed. Red-first: gate archive --record false on C-TOKEN-INTEGRITY (or a temp copy of its run/ shape) currently messages "run/ empty" while NaN orphan exists — capture that false sentence in a failing regression before the wording fix.
